sources.method: author-provided library; no public download command exists (ADR 0006)

local_additions.origin: repo-authored routing note for the author-provided HG library; moved out of source/ at code review (source/ must stay upstream-identical)

notes: Author-provided artefact (ADR 0006): the HeteroGNN library is dormant — no canonical workflow consumes it directly (the Stage 1 workflows consume the author HG drug-embedding table produced by it). There is no public download and no recorded upstream commit, so version is explicitly "unknown". `AGENTS.md` (the library's file-content index) is repo-authored and is now declared under `local/`; `source/` holds only the 12 upstream library files. Split from the old lowercase `hg/` directory in ticket 05 (spec §5); only the feature_extract/ and models/ asset trees of the sibling KPGT item are gitignored, so HG code stays tracked.
